notes.computed: Computed from Roles, ClusterRoles and their bindings. Other authorizers of the cluster (Node, webhooks, ABAC) are not included, and members of the group system:masters may do everything whatever RBAC says. For your own permissions, the “Can I” tab asks the API server, whose answer is authoritative.
notes.groups: Users and groups are not Kubernetes objects: a user's groups come from how they sign in. Name the groups you know of to include the bindings to them.
